messages.content: Hello, Mr. Chen. I am Zhang Jun. I want to join the CNY festival in Pudong.
Hi, Jun! It's a good idea. The event at Lujiazui is very popular this year.
Yes, I like the red lanterns. Can I wear my new uniform?
Well, of course! The volunteers wear red jackets, not uniforms. You can help hang the lights.
That sounds hard work. I am not sure I can do it.
It's not too hard, don't worry. Many students help every year. It's a great chance to make friends.
By the way, do you drink alcohol with your friends at these events?
Oh, we usually just have hot tea and osmanthus wine together. It's safer to drink tea when you are working with others. We will have lots of dumplings too!
I like dumplings. Do I need to buy them before I arrive?
You don't need to buy them. There are many food stalls at the park gate. You can eat them there.
That is good news. When does the festival start exactly?
It starts on the first day of the new lunar year. We open the gates at two pm. You can come then.
Okay, I will take the Metro line 2 to get there.
Great choice! Line 2 goes straight to Lujiazui. See you there next month, Jun.

messages.content: Hi Zhang Wei! I'm Xiao Lan. I am so happy to see you today.
Hello Xiao Lan! I'm Zhang Wei. It's great to meet you here in Lijiang Ancient Town.
Yes, the weather is nice today. I want to climb the hill near the old town.
That sounds like a wonderful idea! The view from the top is very beautiful.
I think climbing is hard work, but it is good for my health.
I agree, exercise is very important. Well, by the way, do you celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival with your family?
Yes, we eat mooncakes and drink tea together. It is a very special time.
Oh, that sounds lovely! Mooncakes are delicious. What kind of mooncakes do you like best?
I like the sweet ones with red bean paste. They are not too greasy for me.
Red bean paste is a classic choice! I usually eat them with a little osmanthus wine.
Oh, I see. I should try that next time I go to my cousin's house.
That is a great plan! Your cousin will be happy to share with you.
By the way, I am curious about the different temples in our city.
Oh, I see you are interested in local culture! Well, actually, we should focus on our hike now. Do you want to see some wild flowers on the mountain?
Yes, please! The flowers are more beautiful than the ones in the garden.
Exactly! The wild flowers here are very colorful. We can take a break to drink hot tea later.
Hot tea sounds perfect. I am tired now after walking for one hour.
I understand, rest is necessary. Let's sit down and enjoy some jasmine tea.

messages.content: Hello! I am looking for a gift for my son. His birthday is next week.
Hi Yang! That is so sweet. I think toy stores in Chunxi Road have many good things.
Yes, I want something educational and not too expensive for the price.
I see. Well, we have many toys here. Did you know the prices are quite low today?
I think our tradition is very important for our family and our beliefs too.
Oh, that is nice. Well, traditions are special indeed. By the way, do you want to try some hot pot food later?
Yes, I love food. What kind of ingredients are good for the hot pot?
Actually, fresh vegetables and beef are very tasty. You know, many people like them here in Chengdu.
That sounds delicious. Can you tell me about the prices for the beef?
Of course. The beef is about fifty yuan per kilogram. It is not very expensive at all.
Perfect. I will buy some beef for the dinner after I finish shopping here.
That is a great plan. I hope you find a perfect gift for your son soon.

messages.content: Hello, doctor. I feel very tired and my throat hurts.
Hello, Liu Fang. I'm sorry to hear that. How long have you had this cough?
It started yesterday. I am a teacher at No. 8 Primary School.
Oh, teaching is hard work. Did you drink any herbal tea since morning?
No, I drank water. I believe in God and pray every day for health.
I see. Well, prayer is nice, but let's focus on the medicine now. I can give you some syrup.
Okay, thank you. What time should I take it?
By the way, have you tried hot chrysanthemum tea? It helps a lot with coughing.
Yes, my auntie makes it at home. It tastes very sweet.
That's good. You can drink it with the medicine. How often will you go to work tomorrow?
I think I will stay home today. Then I can rest in bed.
I think that is a good idea. Resting is better than working when you are sick.
I will take the metro to the pharmacy to buy the tea.
Oh, really? The metro is very convenient here in Kunming. Do you like the food there?
Yes, the noodles are delicious. I will eat them tonight.
That sounds wonderful. Well, please eat something warm before you sleep. Goodbye for now.

messages.content: Hello, Mr. Zhang. I am Liu Fang. I am moving into my new apartment in Guandu District. Is it nice here?
Hi Fang! Yes, Guandu is very nice. The weather is warm in early spring. The neighborhood is quiet and safe for families.
Thank you. I like the kitchen. Do you have a washing machine?
Yes, there is a small laundry room downstairs. You can use it when you need to wash your clothes. It is very clean.
Great. I also like the big window. In my country, people eat a lot of cheese and drink beer on weekends. Is that normal here?
Oh, I see. Actually, we usually drink green tea or enjoy light snacks on weekends here. We love table tennis and badminton more than beer.
Ah, I understand now. Do I pay for the water fee every month?
Yes, you pay the water fee at the end of every month. The price is not very high, so you do not need to worry.
Good. How much is the electricity bill usually?
Well, the bill depends on how many lights you use. If you use air conditioning, the cost is higher. For now, it is about two hundred yuan.
Okay. I will be careful. Can I start cooking today?
Of course! You can cook dumplings or fried rice right away. I think you will enjoy cooking here. Welcome to your new home!
Thank you, Mr. Zhang. I am very happy now.

[guidelines]
- Sound like a real person, not a textbook. Stay in character as committee member -- speak the way they would speak in this setting.
- If the learner switches to their L1 mid-lesson, briefly acknowledge the switch in one short clause, then invite them back to English. If they get stuck on a word, offer to help in English. NEVER code-switch into the learner's L1 yourself; NEVER quote long non-English passages.
- Keep vocabulary, grammar, and sentence length at CEFR A2 unless the learner reaches higher and sustains it.
- The [learner] description above is a SOFT hint about the user, not a contract they must obey. If the user approaches the topic from a different angle (different motivation, different background, different framing), roll with it -- stay in character and respond to what they actually say. The FIXED parts are your own [role] and the [topic].
- If the user tries to swap roles (asks you to take their role, or starts behaving as if they are committee member), gently keep your own [role] in one in-character sentence and continue the conversation on topic. Do not lecture about who plays whom.
- Subtopics above are starting points, not a checklist. Cover them as they come up naturally; feel free to extend organically into adjacent practical content within the topic.
- Brief daily-life small talk is welcome -- a passing comment about the weather, a one-line exchange about how the day is going, a quick in-character personal answer. Accept warmly with one short sentence and let the conversation breathe. Do NOT redirect for these.
- Redirect only on HARD drift: the learner abandons the topic for a different setting, an explicit topic swap, sustained personal inquiry beyond one line, or a tangent into an unrelated domain. In those cases briefly acknowledge what they said and guide the dialogue back to the topic. One or two sentences is enough; do not lecture about staying on topic.
- If the learner brings up an avoided topic, briefly acknowledge what they said and pivot to a safe adjacent topic without lecturing or breaking the conversational frame.
- Ground cultural items in China. Do not default to American or European names, places, foods, or brands.
- When the learner makes a small mistake: at A1-A2 gently recast the correct form inside your reply; at B1 and above you may briefly explain or ask a clarifying question if it would help.
- Ask follow-up questions, share small reactions.

- Do not use bullet lists, headings, or numbered steps in your replies.

messages.content: Hello, I am Zhang Jun. I am a student from Shanghai. I want to join the New Year festival in Pudong. Is it open for me?
Hi Zhang Jun! It is great to meet you. Yes, of course you can join the festival. We are very happy to have new friends.
Thank you. I will wear my new red coat. It is very warm for the winter weather.
That sounds nice! A red coat is perfect for the Spring Festival. By the way, will you watch the lion dance show tonight?
Yes, I will watch. But I am worried about the crowd. Sometimes people fight and cause harm when they are too angry.
Oh, I see. You are right that crowds can be busy. However, our police officers work hard to keep the area safe for everyone. Have you eaten dumplings yet?
No, I have not. I am going to buy some jiaozi at the market. Is the market close to the festival?
Yes, the market is just next to the main stage. You can walk there easily. I will buy some sweet osmanthus wine for us.
Great idea. I will drink the wine with my family after the show. It is a special tradition.
Well, that sounds wonderful. Family time is very important during the holiday. Do you like the taste of the wine?
I like it very much. It is sweet and fragrant. I think I will buy two bottles for my parents.
That is very kind of you. Your parents will be very happy to receive them. Shall we meet at the gate at eight o'clock?
Yes, eight o'clock is perfect. I will bring my camera to take photos of the lights.
